The Uttar Pradesh MLC election results have delivered a political setback for the BJP in Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s parliamentary constituency of Varanasi. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav claimed that his party’s victory in the Varanasi graduates’ constituency was being delayed, alleging pressure on officials and irregularities during counting.
The SP retained the Varanasi teachers’ seat, while its candidate Ashutosh Sinha maintained a strong lead in the graduates’ constituency.
